method: Exact-headword Cambridge indexed web searches, four queries per call; incomplete definitions and pronunciations retried with headword/phonetic pages. Negative verb also verified against Collins. Original Chinese summaries and original English sense examples. IPA evidence preserves indexed optional-sound whitespace; displayed IPA removes whitespace only. Mobile decoration variant retains Cambridge Academic Content notation rather than converting it.
